evidence.title: Multiboard - Open-Source Kanban for Modern Teams
GitHub - olliethedev/multiboard: Minimal Kanban platform with authentication, multi-tenant organizations, and kanban boards.

name: Multiboard
summary: Self-hostable Kanban platform for teams: drag-and-drop boards, multi-organization auth and auto-generated APIs.
description: A minimal Kanban platform you run yourself, built with Next.js, better-auth, Prisma, ZenStack and shadcn/ui. Drag-and-drop boards with unlimited columns, real-time collaboration, multi-organization support, rich text task descriptions, file attachments, notifications, and an admin blog. ZenStack generates type-safe REST APIs with an OpenAPI schema and Scalar documentation; deploys to Vercel or your own infrastructure. MIT licensed.
contains: drag-and-drop kanban boards with unlimited columns
multi-organization: manage multiple teams in one place
real-time collaboration with comments and notifications
rich text task descriptions (Tiptap) and file attachments
auto-generated type-safe REST APIs with OpenAPI schema and Scalar docs
admin blog post management with draft posts
deploys to Vercel or self-hosted infrastructure
